description:
Once sorta passionate lovers, Ha-Sol and Jin-Yul are now nothing more than each other's "exes." After completing his mandatory military service and returning to university, Jin-Yul unexpectedly crosses paths with Ha-Sol on campus. Uncomfortable with the awkward baggage of their shared history, Jin-Yul does everything in his power to avoid his former flame. However, destiny takes a bizarre and terrifying turn when a malicious ghost—one that had been relentlessly stalking Jin-Yul—takes complete possession of Ha-Sol's body. 

Driven by the spirit's dark, uninhibited desires, the boundary between the supernatural and the carnal quickly dissolves. Trapped together by this paranormal anomaly, the former couple finds themselves pushed into an intense, feverish intimacy, crossing boundaries and indulging in raw, physical acts they never even dared to attempt back when they were actually dating. Their unresolved past colliding with possession sparks an uncontrollable, forbidden fire between them.

(Source: Lezhin US)
